errors.text: The proposed synthesis method is not an intervention applied to the specified starting state of already-crystalline, near-equiatomic solid-solution nanoparticles.
The cited catalyst evidence only covers synthesis near 673 K and catalytic testing at approximately 573–673 K, so it does not support stability in the requested 773–1173 K regime.
The hypothesis predicts improved stability without addressing the target instability mechanism: active diffusion, Au/Cu surface segregation, melting, evaporation, and size-dependent reshaping.
No support-specific, size-specific, atmosphere-specific, or compositional limits are given beyond the generic definition of a high-entropy alloy.
